samples.summary: Untrusted coverage.json can now permanently suppress NEVER TRIED entries via the new `usedControls` field
samples.evidence: scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1166 normalises every persona record from the on-disk coverage file with `mergeCoverage(null, record)`, documented there as turning "a file someone edited by hand" into "either valid coverage or empty coverage". Before this change, a record whose `keyVersion` did not match contributed nothing about which controls were clicked (its `shapes` were dropped by the version gate at hunt-ui-coverage.mjs:310-312). Now `mergeCoverage` reads `next.usedControls` (hunt-ui-coverage.mjs:404) outside the version gate and `renderCoverageBrief` (hunt-ui-coverage.mjs:492) subtracts those names from the inventory, so any string list in that file — hand-edited, stale, or written by a run against a different surface — removes those controls from the brief's most valuable section for ever, with no sha/provenance to age it out. Fix belongs on the new code: either provenance-tag `usedControls` entries like `inventory` does, or intersect them with the inventory before trusting them.

samples.summary: `mergeCoverage`'s output shape changed (new `usedControls` key) — the persisted coverage.json contract now differs from the version of these scripts CI runs from `main`
samples.evidence: scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1240 writes the merged records straight to the shared `--coverage` file, and the review/hunt workflows execute a `main` checkout of the same scripts (.trusted/scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1137 is that copy, reading the same default path). The old code ignores `usedControls` entirely, so a coverage file written by this branch and later read by the older script silently loses the carried used-set and re-announces the whole surface as untried after a key bump — the exact regression this change fixes. Additive and forward-compatible, so no caller is broken, but the two versions disagree about the same file. No other reader of the record shape exists: grep for `mergeCoverage|coverageFromJournal|renderCoverageBrief|\.shapes|untried` across scripts/ finds only hunt-ui-coverage.mjs, its test, and hunt-ui.mjs:47-50/1166/1403.
